content.short: Masa uses Soulbound Tokens to represent and manage users' attributes in Web3 and the real world.
content.description: Masa is a Soulbound Token Identity Protocol that uses SBTs to encode users' attributes in Web3 and in the real world. It provides a protocol-level abstraction that enables full management of SBTs and the data attached to them. The Masa Protocol delivers the building blocks for a Web3 identity layer capable of encapsulating any information attributed to an individual, whether in the real world or Web3. Credit scoring is a core function of financial systems, and Masa aims to bring that on-chain.
